app.name: FileHop
app.tagline: Any file, any format, on your device.
app.title: FileHop — any file, any format, on your device
app.description: FileHop converts images, PDFs, data and archives in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
app.needs_js: FileHop needs JavaScript. Turn it on in your browser, then reload this page.
hero.h1: Convert anything, and let nothing leave this device
hero.lead: Drop an image, a PDF, a spreadsheet or an archive. FileHop reads it here, in this tab, with your own CPU. There is no upload button because there is no upload. The one exception is the optional “Save to PixelHop” button: when you press it, that one file is sent through FileHop’s server to your PixelHop library, and FileHop does not keep it.
hero.proof: Watch the Network tab while a conversion runs: it stays empty.

privacy.title: What this page sends
privacy.body: Nothing, except what you choose to send yourself with the optional “Save to PixelHop” button. Files are opened with the File API, decoded and encoded in this tab, and handed back through a blob URL. There is no server-side conversion and no queue, and no account is needed. If you sign in with HOP ID, the server keeps only your session, never a file.

privacy.network_note: Fonts, icons and code come from this same origin.
confirm.drop_body: Files in the queue: {n}. They and their results leave this tab's memory; a result you have not downloaded is gone.
confirm.clear_body: Cards to remove: {n} (done, failed or stopped). A result you have not downloaded is gone.
how.title: Three steps, no round trip
how.s1_p: The type is read from the bytes, not from the name, so a JPEG called .txt still opens.
how.s2_p: Each job runs off the main thread, one worker per slot, so the page keeps scrolling.
how.s3_p: Results stay in memory until you take them. Remove a card and its bytes are gone.
formats.title: What goes in, what comes out
formats.images_v: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, TIFF, ICO, SVG in → WebP, AVIF, JPEG, PNG, PDF out. Resize, and metadata is stripped because it never reaches the encoder.
formats.pdf_v: Merge, split, rotate, pick pages, render pages to PNG or JPEG, read the document info.
formats.data_v: CSV, TSV, JSON and YAML, converted both ways with the header row kept.
formats.text_v: Markdown to HTML, HTML to Markdown or plain text.
formats.archive_v: ZIP and TAR listed and repacked, GZIP both ways, any file wrapped into a ZIP.
formats.hash_v: SHA-256, BLAKE3 and MD5, streamed so a 2 GB file does not have to fit in memory.
formats.soon: Not here yet, on purpose: DOCX/LaTeX (needs pandoc), RAR and 7z (read-only, no WASM yet), video and audio (needs WebCodecs work).
footer.note: Self-hosted, no trackers, no third-party scripts.
licenses.title: Libraries in this build
licenses.body: Each one is bundled or vendored here; nothing is loaded from a third-party CDN.
err.title: That did not work
err.cannot_decode: The browser could not decode this file. The bytes may be damaged, or the format is not supported by this browser.
err.avif_not_supported: This browser cannot write AVIF. Choose WebP instead — it is supported everywhere FileHop runs.
err.encoder_missing: The encoder refused that format. Try another target.
err.bad_page_selection: That page range does not match the document. Try something like 1-3,7.
err.archive_too_big: The archive expands past 4 GB, which is beyond what one tab should hold.
err.archive_ratio: The archive expands suspiciously far for its size, so it was stopped before it could fill memory.
err.json_parse: That file is not valid JSON.
err.merge_needs_two: Merge needs at least two PDFs in the queue.
err.csv_parse: That file could not be read as a table.
err.unsupported: That conversion is not available yet.
err.worker_crash: The worker stopped unexpectedly. The file may be too large for this device.
err.out_of_memory: This device ran out of memory for this file. Try a smaller max width.
err.archive_unsafe_path: The archive contains a path that points outside itself (../). It was refused.
err.archive_bad_zip: That file is not a readable ZIP or GZIP archive.
err.svg_needs_main_thread: This SVG has to be rendered in the page, which is not available right now. Reload and try again.
toast.limit: The queue holds 50 files at a time. {added} of {total} were added; convert or clear this batch first.
licenses.no_agpl: PDF reading uses pdf.js, not MuPDF. No AGPL engine is present in this build.

auth.err_invalid: This sign-in link is not valid any more. Please try again.
auth.err_failed: Signing in failed on our side. Please try again in a moment.
dash.title: Dashboard — FileHop
dash.never_uploaded: Your files are never uploaded. Everything is converted on this device. The one exception is the optional “Save to PixelHop” button: when you press it, that one file is sent through FileHop’s server to your PixelHop library, and FileHop does not keep it.
auth.err_cookies: Your browser did not keep the sign-in cookie, so FileHop cannot sign you in. Allow cookies for this site and try again.
auth.err_hub: HOP ID cannot be reached right now, so FileHop cannot sign you in. Please try again in a moment.
send.title: Send between devices — FileHop
send.h1_pre: Send a file straight across, and let
send.lead: Pick a file on one device and receive it on another. It travels directly between the two, encrypted. FileHop only introduces them: nothing is uploaded or stored.
send.scan: Scan this code with the other device, or type the number there.
send.verify_hint: Both screens must show the same number. If they differ, someone may be in between: press “They differ”.
send.verify_wait: Waiting for the other person to confirm…
send.verify_note: This check also covers the introduction through FileHop’s server: it cannot sit in the middle unnoticed.
send.ready: Connected. Choose a file to send.
send.route_host: Direct connection on the same network
send.unscanned: Files are not scanned by FileHop. Only accept files from people you know.
send.limit: You can send up to {mine} per file; the other device up to {peer}.
send.done_out: Delivered. The other device checked it and it matches.
send.done_in: Received and checked: the file matches what was sent.
send.saved_fs: Saved to the place you chose.
send.saved_private: Kept in this browser until you close the tab. Save it now.
send.err_no_direct: These two devices cannot connect directly
send.err_no_direct_body: Some networks block a direct link between two devices. Nothing was sent. Try one of these:
send.way_wifi: Put both devices on the same Wi-Fi network, then start again.
send.way_hotspot: Connect one device to the other one’s phone hotspot.
send.way_apps: Share it through PixelHop or NoteHop instead.
send.err_room_unknown: That room does not exist or has expired.
send.err_room_full: That room already has two devices.
send.err_room_expired: The room expired after 10 minutes. Start a new one.
send.err_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
send.err_rate_limited_rooms: Too many new codes from this network this hour. Try again later, or type the code shown on the other device.
send.err_room_empty: The device that showed this code has already left. Ask for the code on its screen now.
send.switch_body: This ends the connection you have now.
send.err_busy: FileHop is busy. Try again soon.
send.err_protocol: The other device broke the rules of the handshake, so the connection was closed.
send.err_commit_mismatch: The handshake did not check out, so the connection was closed. Start again.
send.err_unsupported: This browser cannot do peer-to-peer connections.
send.why_too_big: Larger than the limit for the sender.
send.why_hash_mismatch: The file did not match what was sent, so it was discarded.
send.why_size_mismatch: The size did not match what was sent, so the file was discarded.
send.why_declined: The other device declined the file.
send.why_busy: The other device is already receiving a file.
send.why_storage: This device could not store the file (not enough space?).
send.why_too_big_for_memory: This browser cannot hold a file this large. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer.
send.privacy_note: The other device and the STUN server can see this device’s public IP address; that is how two devices find a route.
save.notice: This file will be sent through FileHop’s server to your PixelHop library. FileHop does not keep it.
save.err_no_account: Open PixelHop once while signed in, then try again.
save.err_too_large: This file is larger than PixelHop accepts ({max}).
save.err_unsupported_type: PixelHop does not accept this kind of file.
save.err_rate_limited: Too many saves. Wait a minute and try again.
save.err_not_signed_in: Sign in again to save to PixelHop.
save.err_failed: Could not save to PixelHop. FileHop kept nothing.
save.err_unsure: PixelHop did not answer in time. The file may already be in your PixelHop library: look there before you try again.
save.err_busy: FileHop is busy saving other files. Try again in a moment.
send.err_handshake_stalled: The two devices connected but did not finish checking each other. Start again.
